scope: Explicit projectile render fields and renderer-mode classification for all 65 canonical implemented main weapons.

verification.retrievalMethod: GitHub connector fetch_file at fixed commit, complete UTF-8 file per weapon

units.rawDistances: Native numerical source fields, retained verbatim. DrawSizeParam does not publish a pixel/metre conversion or mesh dimensions.
units.worldUnitsPerSourceUnitStatus: existing INKWAVE provisional bridge; no independent Switch/stage-size calibration
units.sourceAccelerationToWorldAcceleration: native distance per frame squared * 3600 * worldUnitsPerSourceUnit
units.wikiDUBridge: Community movement descriptions use source value * 10 DU/F. That unit convention does not verify rendered radius in metres or pixels.
units.zeroPolicy: Explicit zero is preserved; an explicitly zero render radius is not replaced with collision or paint size.
units.negativePolicy: Negative offset values and -1 sentinels are retained; their exact Nintendo renderer interpretation is unknown.

distinction.collisionSize: Gameplay hit-test radii. Not used as proof of rendered width.
distinction.paintSize: Ground/wall footprint parameters. Not used as proof of airborne mesh shape.
distinction.geometry: Topology, vertices, curved history, tear outline, shaders, textures and material timing are not recovered by these JSON values.
distinction.rendererModes: Procedural interpretation / preservation rules. These are not extracted Nintendo mesh classifications.

shooterDrawRadius.status: no DrawSizeParam or explicit draw radius in any of 14 canonical Shooter sparse source files

shooterTailFrames.status: spl__BulletShooterTailLengthParam absent in all 14 canonical Shooter files; no certified ordinary weapon default

dualiesTailFrames.status: same tail parameter absent in all 6 canonical Maneuver files

splatlingTailFrames.status: explicit MaxLengthFrame in all 6 canonical Spinner files

existingINKWAVEShooterTailCalibration.status: previous INKWAVE fallback; not an extracted source default and not established by this audit as a controlled retail measurement

defaults.missionDiffusionTailWarning: The old parameter/100 WeaponShooterMissionLv3 DiffusionTailLengthParam declares the same spl__BulletShooterTailLengthParam type and MaxLengthFrame 10. Its different parameter slot, mission context and old version do not establish ordinary 11.3.0 Shooter default 10.

communityShooterMotionDefaults.status: community investigator defaults, not executable default recovery and not visual mesh/tail-size defaults

sources.role: primary dataminer's published extraction; not Nintendo-published engine documentation

sources.url: https://wikiwiki.jp/splatoon3mix/検証/パラメータ情報/メイン
sources.role: community testing page distinguishes DrawSizeParam rendering from CollisionParam/PaintParam; TailID/tail meanings remain tentative
primary community investigation/default table; DiffusionTailLengthParam 10 is not ordinary Shooter MaxLengthFrame proof
retained per-weapon Wiki URL and displayed performance version; not claimed as fresh 65-page retrieval in this sub-audit

publicFootage.frameIndexOrigin: decoded first frame n=0; frame t=n/60
publicFootage.observations: Ink flight is visible during moving gameplay; this edited general promotional clip supplies qualitative silhouette context. No isolated controlled bucket throw or ordinary-Shooter default tail measurement is established here.

conditions.camera: moving third-person game camera; not matched to INKWAVE

publicFootage.claimLimit: Promotional reference footage; not controlled retail 11.3.0 parity.

publicFootage.originalAttribution: Nintendo Splatoon 3 JP website; archive upload 2022-04-26 13:07
publicFootage.mediaStatus: HTTP 403 on direct download; web fetch unsupported video/mp4
publicFootage.claimLimit: Candidate only; not decoded or measured in this audit.

derivativeExceptions.rule: Separate bubbles, no connected bucket sheet, explicit tail min/max/solid all zero.
Spiral core; unit 1 companion proxies have explicit zero draw radii. Do not draw four generic balls or substitute hit size.
Keep three TailID branches 0/1/2; keep zero/nonpositive offset radii suppressed.
One explosive ink glob with its own impact effect; not a nine-glob bucket ribbon.
Two distinct 8-round groups, TailID 0/1, second delay 8F; never merge them into a single undifferentiated sheet.
Vertical groups 3/4 have explicit radius 0.08, distinct from primary 0.48; preserve microdrop distinction.
Wide secondary unit init radius 0.3/end 0.55; source ChangeFrame absent, no fabricated growth duration.
Secondary unit init 0.2/end 0.35, ChangeFrame absent; renderer timing is not recovered.
